_comment: Provenance for every clip in data/footage. These are public reference videos used to test the detector on real crowds. They are NOT RTL buses, NOT Malé, and NOT the operator's CCTV. The UI must display this so nobody mistakes reference footage for network telemetry.

01_bus_stop_people_pexels_1601542_1080p..disclosure: Reference footage from Liverpool. Not Malé, not RTL.
